cases_not_reflecting.title: Sales and Advisor Analysis reports drop a voided invoice and keep its re-invoice
cases_not_reflecting.why: Step 14 expects the note to mention that a voided-then-reinvoiced figure can move up; that comes only from tech plan NFR-010 (developer). The published note says: Sales totals can drop, voided invoices no longer counted, invoices with no customer now included, Service Advisor Analysis changes the same way, walk-in sales count. No void-then-reinvoice line. Step 13 says sources do not say where notes are published — they are now on Confluence 931069964 (draft for release 26.43.0).
